scope: Two-party relay privacy: seal every relayed message except the identity manifest. Same host, isolated Zebra NU7 regtest and Anvil; internal work, not an external audit.

finding.summary: The two-party relay carried the signed quote, the full terms, the consents and the ETH order ID in the clear.
finding.consequence: A relay operator could identify the swap's Zcash funding transaction and its exact amount, which the Zcash chain hides.
finding.corrects: evidence/2026-10-17-two-party.json relay.field_audit said no note data crossed the relay; the full terms included the joint note commitment.

fix.construction: Dedicated per-owner secp256k1 relay key in the identity manifest (pinned by the compared fingerprint). Message key = SHA-256(header || ECDH(ephemeral, recipient) || ECDH(sender, recipient)); ChaCha20-Poly1305 (chacha20poly1305 0.11.0, already in the lockfile via zcash_note_encryption) with the header as associated data. The topic is inside the ciphertext.
fix.relay_accepts: identity manifests, and envelopes with exactly {v, from, to, epk, nonce, ct} from the authenticated sender to the other owner
still_visible_to_relay: identity manifests (public keys, certificates, ETH addresses)
sender, recipient, size and time of each envelope
the step a message belongs to, inferable from order and size

cases: only the recipient opens; a third party and the sender cannot
a forged sender, a flipped ciphertext bit, a swapped direction and a replaced ephemeral key are refused; resealing uses a fresh ephemeral key

two_party_run.command: python3 scripts/two_party.py .local/two-party-003, driven through each app's own page endpoints
two_party_run.restart: Bob's app SIGKILLed and restarted after completion, then both apps restarted on the final code: each reopened its peer's envelopes from its own key and showed the finished exchange (Alice 7/7 steps, Bob 6/6).

earlier_run_two_party_002.result: fail: relay record 3 is neither an identity nor a sealed envelope

limits: Same host and OS account; not separate machines or administration.
The relay can still drop, delay or replay envelopes and see who talks to whom and when.
Manifests are exchanged through the relay; owners must compare fingerprints over a channel they already trust.
public_testnet: No public transaction, deployment or faucet request.
